title: Factorial divisibility of falling products at integer arguments
statement: For $n\in\mathbf N$, let $F_n(T)=\prod_{j=0}^{n-1}(T-j)\in\mathbf Z[T]$, in the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. For every integer $z\in\mathbf Z$ there is an integer $a\in\mathbf Z$ such that $$F_n(z)=\prod_{j=0}^{n-1}(z-j)=n!a.$$ The empty product for $n=0$ is $1$.
